paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 66a, challenging Rav Yosef’s words: “They have not heard what Rav Chanan bar Rava taught Chiyya bar Rav.”[^1]

notes.text: The whole selected Davidson Shabbat 66a paragraph has Rava bar Shira raising the objection and recalling Rav Chanan bar Rava teaching Chiyya bar Rav before Rav. The local Rav titles and teaching direction are supported. Hyman’s description of the objection as directed at Rav Yosef’s words remains his contextual account. The supplied scope, locator and untitled Chiyya remain, without importing the surrounding legal discussion or binding identities.
